quote: I strove with none, for none was worth my strife. / Nature I loved and, next to Nature, Art: / I warm’d both hands before the fire of life; / It sinks, and I am ready to depart.
source: Walter Savage Landor, Finis, the whole poem, no. 576, The Oxford Book of English Verse (ed. Arthur Quiller-Couch, 1900)
